hottoys.title: Hot Toys Store E-commerce
hottoys.problemStatement: Niche collectors require immediate stock transparency and clean catalog filters. This solution maps a relational database structure directly into intuitive inventory controls.
hottoys.description: A full-stack MVC application integrating interactive Razor Pages frontend workflows with a secure database for inventory control.
features: Role-based access control (RBAC) for customers and administrators
Administrative dashboard with chart visualizations for revenue tracking and sales reports

modal.title: Hot Toys Store — System Interface
modal.techStack: ASP.NET CORE CORE MVC & ORACLE DB E-COMMERCE
modal.footer: DESIGNED IN FIGMA • SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE ASP.NET CORE MVC & ORACLE DB

home.title: Welcome to ToyStore
home.desc: The homepage features a dark, elegant minimalist design, focusing heavily on highlighting premium action figures.
home.desc2: The hero banner displays high-contrast visuals with smooth transitions, integrating an intuitive smart search bar at the center to optimize the customer search flow.

featured.title: Distribution by Collection
featured.desc: A section showcasing curated collections like Anime Figures (e.g., 2B), DC Figures (e.g., Superman), and trending releases (e.g., Black Myth Wukong).
featured.desc2: Clean Card UI design with smooth borders, displaying item counts and sub-categories clearly to help users locate interests.

catalog.title: Diverse & Convenient Shopping
catalog.desc: Product categorization by universe or brand, such as DC, Marvel, or Anime.
catalog.desc2: Each product lists detailed specs: high-definition closeups from Hot Toys or InArt, inventory status, local price (VND), and quick action buttons for "Add to Cart" or "View Details".

stats.title: Detailed Analytics Dashboard
stats.desc: The system integrates a dedicated smart admin dashboard for managers to monitor and manage store revenues.
stats.desc2: Includes interactive data charts: line and bar graphs tracking revenue and order volume, pie charts analyzing best-selling products, overall gross income statistics, and user account tables.

homme.title: HOMME Store
homme.problemStatement: Developing a robust e-commerce core combining real-world shipping logistics automation and real-time customer engagement via AI Chatbot and SignalR sockets.
homme.description: An e-commerce system optimized for men's fashion, featuring backend logistics automation, smart AI consultation chatbot, and real-time support hub.
features: Integrated AI Chatbot (Gemini/OpenAI API) and real-time Live Chat with SignalR for instant human escalation
Fully automated shipping operations via Giao Hang Nhanh (GHN) API integration for dynamic shipping fee calculations and label generation
Ensured system security with 3-tier authorization (Admin, Employee, Customer) and secured login sessions using HttpOnly Cookies & Sessions

modal.title: HOMME Store — System Interface
modal.techStack: ASP.NET CORE MVC & MS SQL SERVER PLATFORM
modal.footer: SYSTEM DEVELOPMENT • CORE BACKEND ASP.NET CORE MVC & MS SQL SERVER

catalog.title: Product Catalog Page & Dynamic Filters
catalog.desc: Dynamic left sidebar filter for quick sorting by price range (VND), categories (Shirts, T-shirts, Trousers, Jackets), size (S, M, L...), and color.
catalog.desc2: The system automatically synchronizes with the Giao Hang Nhanh (GHN) API during checkout to calculate accurate shipping fees based on the user's geographical region.

vouchers.title: Voucher & Promotion Management Dashboard
vouchers.desc: Deep admin dashboard panel supporting new voucher creation with configuration: Promo Code, Discount Type (Fixed/Percentage), Issue Limit, and Expiration Date.
vouchers.desc2: The voucher list table displays active statuses and provides instant deactivation actions to control marketing budgets.

chat.title: Multi-channel Customer Support Hub
chat.desc: Multi-threaded communication gateway integrating AI Chatbot to automatically answer customer FAQs using Gemini/OpenAI API.
chat.desc2: SignalR Socket connection allows shoppers to transition to live chat session with admin representatives upon complex inquiries.

treasure.title: Treasure Hunter
treasure.problemStatement: Programming a real-time multiplayer side-scrolling platformer via socket connections, optimizing the core game loop for lag-free performance.
treasure.description: A 2D multiplayer platformer game written in pure Java SE, featuring a custom multithreaded server to synchronize positions and animations.
features: Industry-standard game loop optimized for ultra-high performance: 200 UPS physics logic updates and 120 FPS render draw calls
Custom Multithreaded Server utilizing TCP Sockets to synchronize player movements, combat actions, and status stats in real time
Applied object-oriented design patterns (OOP & State Pattern) to modularize source code, facilitating level expansion and audio triggers

modal.title: Treasure Hunter — Game Interface
modal.techStack: JAVA SE & TCP SOCKET MULTIPLAYER ENGINE
modal.footer: GAME DEVELOPMENT • CORE GAME ENGINE JAVA SE & MULTITHREADING

lobby.title: Start Menu & Nickname Registration
lobby.desc: The main launch screen features a wooden Pixel Art frame with options: Play, Options, Credits, Quit overlaying a purple sky and full moon.
lobby.desc2: The creation dialog requests players to choose a nickname (e.g., "DUKA") to register their socket connection and display their username tags in the shared lobby.

gameplay.title: Synchronized Combat & Level Exploration
gameplay.desc: Players control a pirate character to dodge ground spikes, collect golden chests, and engage in melee combat against crab monsters.
gameplay.desc2: Displays health bars (HP) and stamina gauges at the top left of the window screen. The TCP server synchronizes coordinate movements instantly.

victory.title: Level Completion Panel
victory.desc: Upon defeating enemies and surviving the level, the system triggers the 'LEVEL COMPLETED' wooden board with fast action navigation buttons.
victory.desc2: Allows players to quickly return to the main hub (Home button) or load the next map template (Continue button).
